## 1. Functionality and prototype quality

_Syllabus: the prototype demonstrates the core idea and shows that the solution can work in practice._

**Current state of the model** (generated from the code):

- Variable, Formel (calculated by OpenFisca): 34
- Variable, Eingabe (facts and human decisions entered by the user): 27
- Parameter (values taken from the legal text): 21
- Test cases: 98 in 3 file(s)

**Decisions**

| Date | Decision | Reason | Source | Commit | By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-07 | The limit of 5 subsidised days per week is not enforced; inputs are assumed to stay within it, so care on more than 5 days a week (e.g. Saturdays) overstates the contribution | Inputs are monthly, so the weekly spread of care days is unknown; a fixed conversion (5 days x 4.33 weeks) would wrongly cut months with 23 working days. Most Kitas are open Monday to Friday only | Art. 14 Abs. 4 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `93b5f81` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Calculator output has five blocks: result, conditions met or not met with article, calculation steps, situational hints, fixed disclaimer | The challenge asks to show which facts and rules determined the outcome; draft to be revised by the team | challenge/challenge.md, sub-challenge 1; docs/output-konzept.md | `288a151` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Date and duration rules are not encoded yet (Art. 9 Abs. 2 und 11 Abs. 2 KiBG; Art. 6, 11 Abs. 3, 16 und 25 KiBV); scenarios D1 to D9 are ready | The calculator estimates the amount for one month; these rules change when payments start or end, not the amount | openfisca-CH-SG/README.md, section Provisions not encoded | `fcf09a4` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Art. 17 KiBG (total volume and its adjustment) is not encoded | Needs data on all families in the canton; possible later as a budget simulation | Art. 17 KiBG; openfisca-CH-SG/README.md | `fcf09a4` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Conditions are shown with two states only (erfuellt / nicht erfuellt); no third state "von der Gemeinde zu pruefen", because the municipality checks every application anyway | Team decision; the fixed notice says that the decision of the municipality is binding | Art. 11 Abs. 1 KiBG; docs/output-konzept.md | `1236068` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The massgebendes Einkommen is a mandatory input; without it the calculator shows no amount and no range, but asks for the number, pointing to the last definitive tax assessment | A range would be of little use and the V EG-KVG formula is not available for an own estimate | Art. 5 Abs. 3 KiBG; Art. 9 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `1236068` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Supplementary contributions of the municipality (Z1, Z2) are not asked and set to 0, with a notice that they are not included | The amounts differ by municipality and are not public | Art. 20 Abs. 2 KiBG; Art. 24 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `1236068` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The hourly contribution is shown with three decimals (e.g. 4.125), because it is not rounded; only monthly amounts are rounded to 5 Rappen | Otherwise the calculation steps would not add up (P3: 4.125 x 48 = 198.00) | challenge/szenarien.md, A4 | `8d10af6` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Impossible inputs stop the calculation instead of being counted silently: care hours without care days, a child under 18 months marked as eingeschult, a negative current income | Otherwise the calculator shows wrong amounts (0 or the lower rate) without telling why | Art. 14 Abs. 1 und 4 KiBV (Entwurf); Art. 11 KiBV (Entwurf); team review | `b04ef9a` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Help texts float above the content instead of pushing it down | In the browser test, clicks on the next field missed when the help text of the previous field disappeared and the layout jumped | test in headless Chromium | `68b1352` | Benjamin Pfister |

## 2. Technical design and architecture

_Syllabus: the technical structure is understandable, fits the goal and rests on deliberate design choices._

**Decisions**

| Date | Decision | Reason | Source | Commit | By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-07 | Template demo files are replaced by KiBG rules; a copy is kept in docs/openfisca-template-reference/ as format reference | Template rules are fictional; we only need their format | team decision | `8789ae5`, `ade2141` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Missing or placeholder legal references only warn, format errors block the push | Agreed strictness for the hackathon | team decision | `8789ae5`, `ade2141` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Variables and parameters are named with the German legal terms of the text (snake_case, ASCII) | Lawyers in the team can compare code and text line by line | team decision; OpenFisca principle "line-to-line match" | `ade2141` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Care hours are entered per month; the limit of 12 hours per day is applied as at most care days x 12 | The contribution is computed per month; monthly input is simplest for users and tests | Art. 14 Abs. 4 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `93b5f81` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | The massgebendes Einkommen is entered per person, not computed under the V EG-KVG; the model only adds up whose income counts under Art. 8 KiBV | The V EG-KVG (sGS 331.111) is not part of the challenge material | Art. 5 Abs. 3 KiBG; Art. 8-10 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `93b5f81` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Variables about care, costs and contributions are monthly, income is yearly, dates are eternal | Contributions are paid per month; income rests on the yearly tax assessment | Art. 5 Abs. 3 KiBG; Art. 17 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `93b5f81` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Output texts live in the SvelteKit interface (e.g. texte.de.json); OpenFisca only returns values | Law students can revise texts without touching code; placeholders use the variable names of the rule inventory | team decision | `288a151` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Shares are fractions with unit /1: beschaeftigungsgrad 0.8 = 80 %, thresholds 0.20 and 1.20 | OpenFisca convention; inputs and parameters must use the same unit | Art. 4 Abs. 1 KiBG; team decision | `6dcc9df` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Prefix kibg_ for variables and parameters specific to the childcare contribution, no prefix for general facts (geburtsdatum, beschaeftigungsgrad) | Follows the names in the rule inventory; keeps KiBG rules recognisable | challenge/line-to-line-rules.md; team decision | `6dcc9df` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Names are fixed: formulas and parameters always kibg_ (kibg.), inputs without prefix only for general facts; renamed gefestigte_lebensgemeinschaft, gemeinde_z1/z2 (now kibg_zusatzbeitrag_z1/z2), antrag_aktuelle_gegebenheiten, gesuchsdatum, einrichtung_teilnahmebeginn | Tests and frontend texts depend on the names; terms created by KiBG/KiBV are recognisable by the prefix | challenge/line-to-line-rules.md; team review | `c88109b` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Monthly amounts in francs are rounded commercially to 5 Rappen (minimum and supplementary contribution, canton share); the hourly rate is not rounded; the cost cap applies after rounding; the municipal share is the remainder; parents' remaining costs are costs minus contribution | The text sets no rounding rule; 5 Rappen is the smallest coin | team decision | `2f3d8b5` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | A household is the household of the applicant; roles erziehungsberechtigt (max. 2), kind and partner (max. 1, not erziehungsberechtigt); with separated parents only the applicant is erziehungsberechtigt in the household (provisional, legal team to confirm) | Fits the decisions on O8 (applicant must live in the canton) and O10 (each parent applies for own days); keeps the household small and testable | Art. 2 Abs. 1 KiBG; Art. 7 und Art. 8 Abs. 1 KiBV (Entwurf); challenge/line-to-line-rules.md | `86719f2` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The rounding step of 5 Rappen is a parameter (kibg.rundung), marked as team decision without legal text | Keeps the assumption visible and changeable in one place | challenge/szenarien.md, Annahme A4 | `86719f2` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | kibg_massgebendes_einkommen is monthly (inputs stay yearly); shares are compared with a small tolerance and amounts are rounded in whole Rappen | The household (partner) can change within a year; OpenFisca stores float32, so 0.7 or 274.025 would otherwise be misjudged | team decision; challenge/szenarien.md, A4 | `6b073a8` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Questionnaire order household, persons, one block per child; result per child and as a sum for the family; texts in Sie-form in frontend/src/lib/texte.de.json | Follows the structure of the model (applicant's household, persons, children) | team decision; docs/output-konzept.md | `1236068` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Input errors point to the field where the input is entered (person or household), so the interface can mark the right field | Team review: the frontend maps API errors to input fields | openfisca_ch_sg/tests/test_eingabefehler.py, F5 und F6 | `ac960b5` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Interface design: sober and close to authorities, white/black/green (green approximates the cantonal coat of arms, defined once as --gruen), system font, one page with three sections, large selection buttons, info text on focus, calculate always clickable with a list of missing answers, result in a green box with large amount and expandable details | Team decisions in the design questionnaire | team decision; docs/output-konzept.md | `68b1352` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The interface computes no law: it builds the OpenFisca situation on the server, sends it to /calculate and only formats and selects texts from the returned values; nothing is stored | One source of truth for the rules (OpenFisca); data minimisation | docs/output-konzept.md; Art. 21 KiBV (Entwurf) | `68b1352` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The Vollzugsbeginn 2028-08-01 is a constant in the code (VOLLZUGSBEGINN), next to formula_2028_08 and the parameter dates | OpenFisca parameters cannot hold dates; the placeholder must be changed in all three places once the Vollzugsbeginn is set | Ziff. IV KiBG und KiBV (Entwurf); decision on O1 | `9b52503` | Karla Ruggaber |

**Open legal questions and ambiguities** (from `Question:` lines):

- How is the limit of 5 days per week converted to a month, and which care modules and monthly flat rates apply (guidelines not public)? (`93b5f81`, Karla Ruggaber, 2026-11-07)
- Art. 8 Abs. 1 lit. b KiBV counts, with separated parents, only the income of the applying Erziehungsberechtigte person (and of a partner in a gefestigte Lebensgemeinschaft). The code sums the income of all Erziehungsberechtigte in the household and relies on the convention that only the applicant is entered. Example: father applies (Fr. 51'400), the separated mother (Fr. 80'000) is entered by mistake as second Erziehungsberechtigte with no shared household: code Fr. 131'400, text Fr. 51'400. Should the code use kibg_gesuchsteller so that only the applicant's income counts, as the wording says? (`fcf09a4`, Karla Ruggaber, 2026-11-07)
- Art. 11 Abs. 2 KiBV requires the deviation of 25 % "zum Zeitpunkt der Gesuchstellung"; afterwards the assessment stays until a new assessment is requested under Art. 11 Abs. 3 KiBV. The code checks the 25 % in every month, so it switches back to the tax assessment if the deviation later falls below 25 %, and switches without a new request if it arises later. Should the income at the time of the application be a separate input, checked only once? (`fcf09a4`, Karla Ruggaber, 2026-11-07)
- Is the 30-day time limit of Art. 9 Abs. 2 KiBG met by posting the application on the last day (St. Gallen administrative procedure law) rather than by its arrival? The model uses the date of arrival (A10) (`9b52503`, Karla Ruggaber, 2026-11-07)

## 4. Responsible and ethical technology design

_Syllabus: awareness of privacy, security, fairness, transparency, accountability and the limits of automation._

**Decisions**

| Date | Decision | Reason | Source | Commit | By |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-07 | The calculator never takes discretionary decisions; it refers to the municipality instead | Limits of automation; OpenFisca principle "human decisions are inputs" | Art. 4 Abs. 2 KiBG; Art. 12 KiBV (Entwurf) | `288a151` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Missing inputs give a range instead of an error; every result carries a disclaimer (non-binding estimate, draft ordinance, no data stored) | Transparency about uncertainty and data protection | team decision; Art. 21-23 KiBV (Entwurf) | `288a151` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Default values are conservative: residence, recognised facility and other conditions are false unless entered; me_aktuell -1 means not entered (assessment applies); without a start date a partnership never counts as gefestigt | The calculator must not promise a contribution on facts nobody entered | team decision | `6b073a8` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | If kibg_anspruch is true but the contribution is 0 (no rate in Art. 14 KiBV or income above Fr. 154'000), the interface explains why instead of showing only Fr. 0 | Parents must understand that they meet the conditions but the text sets no amount for their case | Art. 14 und 15 KiBV (Entwurf); docs/output-konzept.md | `fcf09a4` | Karla Ruggaber |
| 2026-11-07 | Confirmed by the team: what is not entered counts as not fulfilled (residence, recognised facility and other conditions) | Team review of the provisional decision | team decision | `0759f0e` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Data protection: the calculator asks no names, AHV number or address; the notice says "Der Rechner speichert Ihre Angaben nicht", the stronger statement only after hosting and logging of the API are clarified | Data minimisation compared with the platform data of Art. 21 KiBV; no promise that is not technically verified | Art. 8 KiBG; Art. 21 bis 23 KiBV (Entwurf); team decision | `1236068` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | Children are labelled "1. Kind", "2. Kind" in all texts; no names are asked | Data minimisation (decision 11) | docs/output-konzept.md; team decision | `8d10af6` | Benjamin Pfister |
| 2026-11-07 | The hints include the 30-day deadline (Art. 9 Abs. 2 KiBG) and the duty to report changes with possible repayment (Art. 13 and 14 Abs. 2 KiBG) | Families should know the deadline and the risk of repayment; R1 in the rule inventory asks the calculator to point this out | Art. 9 Abs. 2, Art. 13 und Art. 14 Abs. 2 KiBG; challenge/line-to-line-rules.md, R1 | `8d10af6` | Benjamin Pfister |

## 5. Documentation and reproducibility

_Syllabus: clear instructions on how the prototype works, how it can be tested and which dependencies or tools are used._

**How to run and test** (details in `RULEBOOK.md`):

```bash
bash tools/setup.sh                       # install OpenFisca + checks
cd openfisca-CH-SG && make test           # run all test cases
cd openfisca-CH-SG && make serve-local    # OpenFisca Web API on :5000
```

  - Decision: Before the start of the contributions (Art. 9 Abs. 2 KiBG, Art. 25 Abs. 1 KiBV) there is no entitlement; the start of the contributions is a condition of kibg_anspruch
  - Decision: In the month in which the contributions start, parents enter only the care days and hours from that day on; more days than remain from that day stop the calculation with an error (assumption A9)
  - Decision: The Gesuchsdatum is the day the application reaches the municipality; Betreuungsbeginn and Gesuchsdatum are mandatory for every child (assumption A10)
  - Decision: The transition rule of Art. 25 Abs. 1 KiBV takes precedence over the 30-day rule; contributions start at the Vollzugsbeginn, but not before the start of care; applications made before the Vollzugsbeginn also count
  - Decision: The date the Amt für Soziales confirmed a facility is optional; if entered, the facility takes part from the first day of the following month and this overrides kibg_einrichtung_angemeldet; "angemeldet" before that month stops the calculation with an error
  - Decision: The Vollzugsbeginn 2028-08-01 is a constant in the code (VOLLZUGSBEGINN), next to formula_2028_08 and the parameter dates

- **Add scenario catalogue and record team decisions on open questions** (`2f3d8b5`, Karla Ruggaber, 16:13)
  - Decision: A child gets the rate for "unter 18 Monaten" for the full first 18 months of life; from the 18-month birthday (first day of the 19th month of life) the rate for "über 18 Monaten" applies
  - Decision: Art. 4 Abs. 1 lit. a and b KiBG apply cumulatively: each parent works at least 20 % and, in a shared household, both together at least 120 %; 120 % / 0 % gives no entitlement unless an exception under Abs. 2 is granted
  - Decision: The income-independent municipal supplement Z2 is paid also above an income of Fr. 154'000; the upper limit of Art. 15 Abs. 2 KiBV applies to the minimum contribution only
  - Decision: A deviation of at least 25 % between current and assessed income counts in both directions
  - Decision: For separated parents the applicant must live in the canton, and the applicant's municipality is responsible
  - Decision: With alternating custody each parent applies for and enters only their own days of actual custody
  - Decision: School year starts on 1 August (placeholder, only needed for the optional date rules)
  - Decision: Age of the child and duration of a partnership are determined on the first day of the month and apply to the whole month
  - Decision: If minimum and supplementary contribution together exceed the costs, the municipal supplement is cut first
  - Decision: Monthly amounts in francs are rounded commercially to 5 Rappen (minimum and supplementary contribution, canton share); the hourly rate is not rounded; the cost cap applies after rounding; the municipal share is the remainder; parents' remaining costs are costs minus contribution
  - Decision: No separate rate for private special schools: entitlement follows from Art. 3 Abs. 2 lit. d KiBG, the amount from the form of care (Kita, schulergaenzende Betreuung or Tagesfamilie)
